name: ACHE Art & Design Agent Framework

research.output: verified source pool, comparison, findings and gaps

concepts.output: distinct concepts, trade-offs and next experiments
input_contract: intent, materials, relevant research and constraints
output_contract: distinct propositions, trade-offs and next experiment

visuals.output: editable diagrams, accurate charts, illustrations and inspected exports
input_contract: visual brief, source data/materials, protected geometry
output_contract: editable source, export and actual inspection record

writing.output: evidence-matched prose with preserved anti-defensive writing
input_contract: operation, author material, evidence map, protected wording
output_contract: clean prose, argument trace and material change notes

verify.output: source-grounded findings with checked scope and severity
input_contract: actual current artifacts, sources and checked scope
output_contract: located findings, counter-evidence and actual verification coverage

critique.output: reasoned critique of intent, form, context and experience
input_contract: visible work, intention, context and relevant criteria
output_contract: reasoned interpretations, alternatives and practical next steps

production.output: prototype, fabrication or interaction plan with real test records
input_contract: concept, dimensions, equipment, resources and uncertainty
output_contract: prototype/test plan or actual observed test record

delivery.output: requested formats, editable sources and bounded verification summary
input_contract: requested outputs, current artifacts and required checks
output_contract: usable outputs, editable sources and bounded completion summary

required_capability_policy: Discover available tools at task time, use suitable connected tools first, and disclose missing capability without inventing results.
subagent_policy: Optional and task-scoped; require explicit user authorization or applicable higher-priority permission; never imply a fresh independent check occurred when it did not.
